summary: Advance a single channel with separately supplied old/new linear operators

identity.direction: Explicit cell/face data to spatial operator or state update
identity.definition: (I-dt*theta*C_new)u_new=(I+dt*(1-theta)*C_old)u_old+dt*((1-theta)*c_old+theta*c_new). C is diffusion plus convection; c includes boundary forcing and explicit source. Output carries new boundary data. No hidden iteration or stopping condition.
identity.geometry: Explicit one-dimensional face grid, cell centers at arithmetic midpoints
identity.coordinates: Caller coordinate X; positive increasing direction
identity.boundary: One scalar Dirichlet value or positive-coordinate Neumann gradient at each end; homogeneous unit cross-section unless metrics supplied
assumptions: Finite converted-binary64 input quantities; caller supplies consistent units and normalization

inputs.name: var_old
inputs.description: Old cell values and old boundary conditions

inputs.name: var_new
inputs.description: New boundary data and output grid; initial value is not a nonlinear iterate

inputs.name: d_old
inputs.description: Old/new coefficient or explicit source; None means absent term
inputs.constraints: Finite explicit real array when supplied

inputs.name: d_new
inputs.description: Old/new coefficient or explicit source; None means absent term
inputs.constraints: Finite explicit real array when supplied

inputs.name: v_old
inputs.description: Old/new coefficient or explicit source; None means absent term
inputs.constraints: Finite explicit real array when supplied

inputs.name: v_new
inputs.description: Old/new coefficient or explicit source; None means absent term
inputs.constraints: Finite explicit real array when supplied

inputs.name: source_old
inputs.description: Old/new coefficient or explicit source; None means absent term
inputs.constraints: Finite explicit real array when supplied

inputs.name: source_new
inputs.description: Old/new coefficient or explicit source; None means absent term
inputs.constraints: Finite explicit real array when supplied

inputs.name: neumann_mode
inputs.description: Boundary face reconstruction strategy for prescribed du/dx

outputs.name: variable
outputs.description: New float64 cell values and new boundary data
outputs.constraints: Finite; equal explicit one-dimensional face shape; no broadcasting

preconditions: Declared shapes, domains and matching scientific conventions; no implicit broadcasting
supported: Advance a single channel with separately supplied old/new linear operators
excluded: Single-channel unit transient coefficient only; coupled source matrices, transient-in/out factors, nonlinear coefficients, internal boundary row replacement and nonlinear solvers are excluded.

Explicit and Crank-Nicolson modes have caller-dependent stability/oscillation constraints; no adaptive timestep or positivity guarantee. The implicit branch solves the tridiagonal system with a banded linear solver; no global stability bound is claimed.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: ValueError for shape/domain/finite/masked input failures; FVM nonnumeric inputs raise TypeError. No partial result.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: FloatingPointError for nonfinite computed results; singular banded systems raise numpy.linalg.LinAlgError.
failure_semantics.nonconvergence: No iteration; theta is one linear solve. No convergence flag is fabricated.
failure_semantics.partial_results: No partial output returned on failure.

python.signature: theta_step(var_old, var_new, dt, *, d_old=None, d_new=None, v_old=None, v_new=None, source_old=None, source_new=None, theta=1.0, dirichlet_mode='ghost', neumann_mode='ghost')

example.description: Advance a zero state by a half-weighted theta step with a unit constant source.
example.code:
import numpy as np
from scirel.fvm import CellVariable,theta_step
v=CellVariable([0.,0.],[0.,1.,2.])
x=theta_step(v,v,.2,source_old=[1.,1.],source_new=[1.,1.],theta=.5)
np.testing.assert_allclose(x.value,.2)
example.expected: The two cell values advance to [0.2, 0.2].

scope: Independent flux conservation, exact linear/constant states, uniform manufactured diffusion convergence and theta causality checks
verification.evidence_ceiling: Named discrete invariants and manufactured uniform-grid convergence; no arbitrary-grid stability/accuracy or full transport-simulation claim.
known_limitations: Single-channel unit transient coefficient only; coupled source matrices, transient-in/out factors, nonlinear coefficients, internal boundary row replacement and nonlinear solvers are excluded.

Explicit and Crank-Nicolson modes have caller-dependent stability/oscillation constraints; no adaptive timestep or positivity guarantee. The implicit branch uses a banded linear solve; no global stability bound is claimed.
